title: Protests Erupt at CJP's Sansad March, Police Use Tear Gas and Batons
summary: On [Date], the CJP organized a march in New Delhi, but it turned violent when protesters clashed with police. The Caravan reported that over 100 people were injured, including several journalists. Police used tear gas and batons to disperse the crowd, while some protesters threw stones at the police. The government said that the protests were 'unlawful' and 'threatened national security'. The opposition alleged that the police crackdown was 'excessive' and 'targeted' certain groups.

sources.headline: Defiance, chaos and repression at the CJP's Sansad March
